newsitem.title: DUBAI: BOXING-EUBANK PLANS TO FIGHT LAMBERG IN DUBAI.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-EUBANK PLANS TO FIGHT LAMBERG IN DUBAI.

text.p: Briton Chris Eubank, former World Boxing Organisation (WBO) middleweight and super-middleweight champion, said on Tuesday he would fight American Shannon Lamberg in Dubai on March 27 in a bid to earn another title shot.
Eubank retired in 1995 but began a comeback in Cairo last October with a lacklustre win over Argentine Louis Barrera.
Lamberg is number three in the WBO rankings.
"The ultimate objective is to be number one again," Eubank told reporters before leaving for London. "I think I have more than a realistic chance.
"I am fighting the number three guy to provide proof that I am serious about my comeback. You are taken seriously only if you win."
Organisers refused to disclose how much prize money was at stake. Eubank plans to donate some to charity.
"Prize money is of little consequence, the most important thing is victory," Eubank said. "Once I win the fight, then I will be eligible for a title fight."
